decks.notes: The deck focuses on utilizing creatures with various abilities and toolbox cards to create combos and overwhelm the opponent. By using cards like Chord of Calling and Eldritch Evolution, the player can search for specific creatures to fit the situation. Creatures like Yawgmoth, Thran Physician and Grist, the Hunger Tide provide valuable removal and card advantage. The deck aims to outvalue opponents with a versatile and aggressive creature strategy, utilizing its toolbox of creatures to adapt to different board states and disrupt the opponent's game plan.

The deck focuses on quickly playing aggressive creatures like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Dragon's Rage Channeler to apply pressure on the opponent while disrupting their game plan with countermagic like Counterspell and Spell Pierce. The deck also utilizes cards like Unholy Heat and Lightning Bolt for removal, allowing the aggressive creatures to continue attacking. The deck's ability to control the board while presenting a fast clock makes it a formidable threat in Modern 1 vs 1 matches.

The deck focuses on aggressive gameplay with a combination of cheap spells and creatures to quickly apply pressure on the opponent. It utilizes various efficient spells like Unholy Heat and Lightning Bolt to deal damage to the opponent's creatures or directly to their life total. The inclusion of powerful creatures like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Murktide Regent further bolsters the aggressive strategy. Additionally, the deck features disruptive cards like Spell Pierce and Counterspell to protect its threats and disrupt the opponent's game plan. The key strategy revolves around tempo, board control, and efficient use of resources to secure a swift victory.

The deck focuses on utilizing Niv-Mizzet Reborn's ability to draw and play multicolored cards efficiently, generating card advantage and board control. The deck includes a variety of powerful multicolored spells and planeswalkers to disrupt the opponent's strategy and establish control over the game. With a mix of removal, card draw, and versatile threats, the deck aims to outvalue the opponent and win through attrition. By carefully managing resources and choosing the right spells to play at the right time, the deck can grind out wins against a variety of decks in the Modern format.

This deck focuses on quickly deploying aggressive creatures like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Murktide Regent, while supporting them with efficient disruption spells like Lightning Bolt, Counterspell, and Spell Pierce. The deck also utilizes cantrips like Mishra's Bauble and Consider to dig through the deck and find threats. The mana base is carefully constructed to support a balanced mix of spells and creatures, allowing for consistent pressure on the opponent while maintaining control over the game.

The key concept of this Rakdos Aggro deck is to apply pressure early and disrupt the opponent's game plan with efficient removal and hand disruption spells. The deck aims to quickly deploy threats such as Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Seasoned Pyromancer while using cards like Grief and Thoughtseize to disrupt the opponent's hand. Additionally, cards like Blood Moon and Terminate provide additional disruption and removal options to keep the opponent off balance. Overall, this deck focuses on aggressive plays and disruption to close out games quickly.

The deck focuses on using efficient creatures and burn spells to quickly apply pressure on the opponent. By utilizing cards like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Murktide Regent, along with removal spells like Lightning Bolt and Unholy Heat, the deck aims to control the board and deal damage quickly. The inclusion of counterspells and disruptive cards like Spell Snare and Spell Pierce helps protect its threats and disrupt the opponent's game plan. Additionally, card selection with Mishra's Bauble and Expressive Iteration helps ensure that the deck can maintain its aggressive game plan.

The deck focuses on using cheap and efficient spells to control the board while pressuring the opponent with aggressive creatures like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Murktide Regent. Blood Moon can disrupt the opponent's mana base, while cards like Unholy Heat and Lightning Bolt provide removal and reach. Expressive Iteration and Counterspell help maintain card advantage and protect your threats. The deck aims to quickly establish a dominant board presence and overwhelm the opponent with its versatile threats and disruptive elements.

The deck focuses on playing low-cost spells and utilizing Cascade mechanic to cast bigger threats for free. With the help of cards like Shardless Agent and Violent Outburst, the deck can quickly flood the board with powerful creatures like Crashing Footfalls and Murktide Regent. It also includes disruptive elements like Force of Negation and Mystical Dispute to protect its game plan. The deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with aggressive plays and tempo advantage, while maintaining some flexibility with cards like Dead / Gone and Fiery Islet.

This Rakdos Aggro deck focuses on disrupting the opponent's hand and board while applying pressure with aggressive creatures like Seasoned Pyromancer, Dauthi Voidwalker, Grief, and Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer. The deck also includes removal spells like Fatal Push, Terminate, and Kolaghan's Command to deal with threats. With a mix of disruption, aggression, and removal, this deck aims to control the game early on and maintain pressure to secure a win. Additionally, the inclusion of cards like Blood Moon and Castle Locthwain offers additional utility and advantage in certain matchups.

This UW Control deck focuses on disrupting opponents with countermagic and removal spells while gaining card advantage through powerful planeswalkers like Teferi, Hero of Dominaria and Jace, the Mind Sculptor. The deck also utilizes various card draw spells and flexible instant-speed effects like Archmage's Charm and Shark Typhoon to maintain control of the game. Additionally, the inclusion of a companion in Kaheera, the Orphanguard provides additional utility and a unique deckbuilding restriction.

The main idea behind this deck is to control the game using cards like Teferi, Time Raveler and Supreme Verdict while ramping up mana with cards like Wrenn and Six and Arboreal Grazer. The ultimate goal is to assemble the combo of Scapeshift and Valakut, the Molten Pinnacle to deal lethal damage to the opponent. Bring to Light provides flexibility in finding key cards, while cards like Dryad of the Ilysian Grove and Omnath, Locus of Creation help to ramp up and fix mana. Leyline Binding and Prismatic Ending provide additional control and removal options to outmaneuver the opponent.

The deck focuses on aggressive plays with a diverse array of creatures and spells to deal damage quickly to the opponent. It utilizes a combination of powerful creatures like Tarmogoyf and Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer, alongside burn spells like Tribal Flames and Lightning Bolt. The inclusion of Scion of Draco allows for potent late-game threats, while Leyline Binding and Stubborn Denial provide protection and control options. The main strategy is to apply pressure early on and maintain board presence to overwhelm the opponent before they can set up their defenses.

The main concept of this UR Aggro deck is to quickly establish board presence and apply pressure on the opponent by using efficient threats like Murktide Regent, Dragon's Rage Channeler, and Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer. The deck also focuses on disrupting the opponent's game plan with card draw spells like Expressive Iteration and Mishra's Bauble, as well as counterspells like Spell Snare and Counterspell. By combining aggressive creatures with disruptive spells, this deck aims to control the pace of the game and overwhelm the opponent before they can stabilize.

The deck revolves around assembling the three Urza's lands to generate large amounts of mana, allowing for powerful plays and the casting of big threats like Wurmcoil Engine and Ulamog, the Ceaseless Hunger. It also includes control elements like Oblivion Stone and Dismember to deal with opposing threats. Karn, the Great Creator and Karn Liberated provide additional utility and disruption, while cards like Sylvan Scrying and Expedition Map help find the Urza's lands. The deck aims to control the game state while quickly ramping into powerful threats to overwhelm the opponent.

This deck focuses on utilizing cheap and efficient spells to control the board and pressure the opponent's life total. By mixing counterspells with powerful threats like Murktide Regent and Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer, the deck seeks to disrupt the opponent's game plan while consistently applying pressure. Mishra's Bauble and Expressive Iteration help dig for key cards, while Unholy Heat and Lightning Bolt provide removal and reach. The inclusion of Otawara, Soaring City adds an extra layer of flexibility and resilience to the deck's aggressive game plan.
